meta_description:
30K likes, 218 comments - diipakhosla on September 30, 2026: "Meet the reset your scalp’s been missing : the Champi Clarifying & Detox Shampoo 🫧🩶 

Between styling products, dry shampoo, pollution, excess oil and even hard water, there’s a LOT that can build up on your scalp over time. Soo, we created an extra step over the last 18 months: a proper weekly reset that deeply cleanses without leaving your scalp feeling stripped 🚿

What’s to love:
🫧 Powered by 13+ scalp-first actives, microbiome-supporting ingredients, and Ayurvedic botanicals 
🫧 Deeply cleanses and gently exfoliates the scalp without drying or stripping it
🫧 96 hours of oil control in just one wash*
🫧 Made for oily scalps, dry flakes, irritation and for everyone who needs a thorough scalp cleanse 
🫧 Sulphate-free & 93% natural 

Use 1x/week as a weekly treatment and follow up with the Bond Repair Conditioner and 2x/week if your scalp gets oily quickly or is buildup-prone 🛁

Now live in India on indewild.com & exclusively at @mynykaa 🛒".
